raw.query:
WITH pairs(policy, live_run_id, sim_run_id) AS (
  VALUES
    ('forecast'::text, 'live:arm:live_fc'::text, 'live:twin_fc_p90_cap4'::text),
    ('reactive'::text, 'live:arm:live_re'::text, 'live:twin_re_cap4'::text)
),
live AS (
  SELECT p.policy, p.sim_run_id, d.run_id AS live_run_id, d.window_name,
         a.ttft_p99_ms, a.chunk_latency_p99_ms, a.request_count,
         a.replica_seconds
  FROM pairs p
  JOIN provenance.v_dim d
    ON d.run_id = p.live_run_id
   AND d.is_current
   AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
  JOIN provenance.v_live_anchor a
    ON a.arm = replace(p.live_run_id, 'live:arm:', '')
   AND a.policy = p.policy
),
sim AS (
  SELECT p.policy, d.run_id AS sim_run_id, d.window_name,
         MAX(i.bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_bound_ms,
         MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_p99_ms,
         MAX(i.bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl') AS chunk_bound_ms,
         MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl') AS chunk_p99_ms,
         BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) AS any_sla_violation,
         MIN(i.n_requests) AS denominator_requests,
         BOOL_AND(i.has_raw_backing) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_has_raw_backing,
         s.decode_worker_seconds + s.prefill_worker_seconds AS replica_seconds
  FROM pairs p
  JOIN provenance.v_dim d
    ON d.run_id = p.sim_run_id
   AND d.is_current
   AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
  JOIN provenance.v_infraction i
    ON i.run_id = d.run_id
   AND i.is_current
  JOIN provenance.llm_run_summary s ON s.run_id = d.run_id
  GROUP BY p.policy, d.run_id, d.window_name,
           s.decode_worker_seconds, s.prefill_worker_seconds
)
SELECT l.policy, l.live_run_id, s.sim_run_id,
       l.window_name AS live_window, s.window_name AS sim_window,
       l.request_count AS live_requests,
       s.denominator_requests AS sim_denominator_requests,
       l.ttft_p99_ms AS live_ttft_p99_ms,
       s.ttft_p99_ms AS sim_ttft_p99_ms,
       s.ttft_bound_ms,
       l.chunk_latency_p99_ms AS live_chunk_p99_ms,
       s.chunk_p99_ms AS sim_chunk_p99_ms,
       s.chunk_bound_ms,
       (l.ttft_p99_ms > s.ttft_bound_ms OR
        l.chunk_latency_p99_ms > s.chunk_bound_ms) AS live_fails_sla,
       s.any_sla_violation AS sim_fails_sla,
       ROUND((100 * ABS(l.ttft_p99_ms - s.ttft_p99_ms) /
              s.ttft_p99_ms)::numeric, 6) AS ttft_p99_diff_pct_of_sim,
       ROUND((100 * ABS(l.chunk_latency_p99_ms - s.chunk_p99_ms) /
              s.chunk_p99_ms)::numeric, 6) AS chunk_p99_diff_pct_of_sim,
       l.replica_seconds AS live_replica_seconds,
       s.replica_seconds AS sim_replica_seconds,
       ROUND((100 * ABS(l.replica_seconds - s.replica_seconds) /
              s.replica_seconds)::numeric, 6) AS replica_time_diff_pct_of_sim,
       s.ttft_has_raw_backing
FROM live l
JOIN sim s USING (policy, sim_run_id)
ORDER BY l.policy
raw.observed: Current, non-superseded cap-4 anchor rows: forecast live/sim both pass (TTFT 695.16032053/651.1395370000973 ms; chunk 5.52012762027014/5.287486999994144 ms), with replica-time difference 5.263541%; reactive live/sim both fail (TTFT 3531.453221559999/3494.725887000095 ms; chunk 161.78737368000873/160.25963300000876 ms), with p99 differences 1.050936%/0.953291% and replica-time difference 7.640839%. Live/simulation denominators are 3092/3093 for forecast and 3089/3093 for reactive; both window fields are NULL.
